label: VERIFIED
extraction: General Agent Evaluation (Exgentic): Framework gap - no evaluation harness allows any agent to plug into new benchmark unchanged. Three artifacts: (1) Unified Protocol - benchmark-agent mediation protocol bridging agent interfaces (CLI, tool-calling APIs, MCP) and benchmarks through canonical task/context/actions representation, (2) Exgentic - evaluation harness implementing Unified Protocol, surfacing benchmarks through interface accessible to any general-purpose agent with any backbone model, (3) Open General Agent Leaderboard at www.exgentic.ai. Benchmarks 5 prominent agents across 6 environments. General agents generalize across diverse environments achieving performance comparable to domain-specific agents without environment-specific tuning.
